style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted fantasy deckbuilder; adventurous with a light touch of humor. This art belongs to ONE playable hero, an original half-dragon warrior, and shows her power only through her motifs: copper-red dragon scales, curved black-iron claws with glowing ember-orange cracks, a crimson spade-tipped dragon tail, translucent ember-fire wings, dragon blood and dragon fire. Never draw her face or body. Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, copper-red #B5532E, crimson #8E1B23, ivory #EFE2C4, amber #F2A93B, ember #FF8A2A. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for runes, magic and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.

assets.prompt: A round copper-red dragon-scale orb rimmed with glowing ember-orange cracks; broad warm amber center left uncluttered for a game-drawn cost. Centered isolated icon on transparent background with 10 percent clear margin, bold blackened-iron outer contour, simple large internal shapes and no cast shadow; no lettering or numerals.
